page_title: EVE 0-0 BRE | Everton v Brentford 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Ashley Young (Everton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. A free kick to Brentford.
90+3' Ashley Young (Everton) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+3' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Everton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+3' Ashley Young (Everton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

90+1' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) who sends his header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
90+1' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford). A free kick is awarded to Everton.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Dwight McNeil (Everton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
88' Kevin Schade (Brentford) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vitaly Janelt as he is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
85' Dwight McNeil (Everton) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
84' Igor Thiago (Brentford) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. Free kick. Everton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
84' Beto (Everton) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
82' Ashley Young (Everton) fails to send in a decent cross from the free kick from the edge of the box. His effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
82' Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game. One of the players from Brentford won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Everton have been awarded a free kick.

81' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
81' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Brentford will take a free kick near the side line.

80' Beto (Everton) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
79' One of the players from Everton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
77' Beto (Everton) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mark Flekken makes a comfortable save.
75' Dwight McNeil (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
72' Here is a change. Abdoulaye Doucoure is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Orel Mangala (Everton).
72' Substitution. Beto (Everton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jesper Lindstrom walks off.
72' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Yoane Wissa will be replaced by Igor Thiago (Brentford).
72' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Schade (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Mikkel Damsgaard.
71' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
70' Ashley Young (Everton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
69' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
69' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken reads it well and gathers the ball.
68' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quickest to intercept the ball.
64' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
64' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Jordan Pickford.

62' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Vitali Mykolenko (Everton), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
62' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
61' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement. Brentford earn a free kick.
59' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
58' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) takes a short corner kick.
58' Mark Flekken leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dwight McNeil (Everton). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
57' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
56' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
55' The game is interrupted as Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is flagged offside.
54' Mark Flekken (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
53' Mark Flekken (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

51' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Mark Flekken has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
50' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
48' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
48' He should have scored! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
47' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Everton.

45+1' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle. Brentford win a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
43' Thomas Frank appears to have said too much and referee Chris Kavanagh comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
43' Jordan Pickford (Everton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
41' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Chris Kavanagh had no choice but to send Christian Norgaard (Brentford) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

41' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Christian Norgaard (Brentford), but referee Chris Kavanagh must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
41' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Pickford (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
38' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

37' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Jordan Pickford. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
34' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Dwight McNeil (Everton) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

33' What a big chance! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
31' Wow, what an escape. Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
29' Dwight McNeil (Everton) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
29' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Everton earn a corner.
28' A player from Everton commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Brentford have a free kick.
28' Dwight McNeil (Everton) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

27' Mark Flekken was forced into action to thwart Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball goes out for a corner. Everton can continue in their attacking effort.
26' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) touches the ball with his hand. Everton are awarded the free kick.
26' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
25' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Brentford are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
24' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
23' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' Dwight McNeil (Everton) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

18' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brentford.
17' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) works the corner short.
15' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton).
15' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

14' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Everton in a dangerous position.

14' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Sepp van den Berg (Brentford), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
12' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is caught offside!
12' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
10' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
9' Dwight McNeil (Everton) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
7' A pass lands at the feet of Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

6' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
6' Everton win a corner.
5' Everton get a corner.
4' A lofted pass picks out Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. Corner kick. Everton will have an opportunity.
3' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' The first half has started.
Everton will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is introduced as the referee for today's match.
